name: Sahha Dark Neon Blog
lineage: Blog build v1 (sahha-static-blog, generated output/) -> v2 (this, static index.html) -> v3 (PHP + 5-theme themes.css) -> sahha-blog-system (PHP/MySQL CMS); all share the same green/purple-on-near-black brand tokens
signature: green-to-purple 135deg gradient text logo and hairline green borders over near-black
description: The recurring Sahha blog identity: spring-green #56ffb5 and electric purple #7B00FF accents, gradient logo text and neon hairline borders on an almost-black #0A0808 canvas. Four separate blog builds (static v1/v2/v3 and the PHP blog-system) iterate on this one look.

name: Sahha Blog Theme — Light Professional
lineage: Alternate palette #2 of 5 in sahha-static-blog-3 themes.css; swaps the dark neon brand for corporate blue
signature: white header with boxed nav links that gain blue borders on hover/active
description: Bootstrap-flavoured light theme: white surfaces, gray-700 text and a #0066cc link blue with soft blue-tinted active states. The conservative sibling of the dark neon blog.

name: Sahha Blog Theme — Ocean Depth
lineage: Alternate palette #3 of 5 in sahha-static-blog-3 themes.css
signature: deep navy backgrounds with translucent indigo card washes and sky-blue links
description: Deep-sea navy dark theme (#0a1628) lit by tailwind blue-400 #60a5fa and indigo #818cf8, with glassy rgba(30,64,175,0.1) cards. Calmer and cooler than the green/purple default.

name: Sahha Blog Theme — Warm Corporate
lineage: Alternate palette #4 of 5 in sahha-static-blog-3 themes.css
signature: coffee-brown backgrounds with amber links and cream text
description: Warm espresso-brown dark theme with amber #f59e0b accents and cream #fef3c7 typography. Reads like a premium finance/energy blog rather than clinical health.

name: Sahha Blog Theme — Professional Dark
lineage: Alternate palette #5 of 5 in sahha-static-blog-3 themes.css
signature: achromatic charcoal palette where white itself is the accent
description: Stripped monochrome dark theme — charcoal #1a1a1a, #242424 cards, white links. Spotify-like neutrality; semantic greens/yellows only appear for status.

name: Sahha Mental Health API Demo
signature: indigo primary with emerald secondary on white; sticky navbar plus three-column docs layout (docs.css)
description: A light SaaS-style 'Mental Health API' demo site: white surfaces, indigo #6366f1 primary, emerald #10b981 accents, Inter throughout, with a dedicated sticky-sidebar documentation layout.

name: Sahha Resources Editorial
lineage: Astro blog (Bear Blog base) with Geist tokens; identical global.css in new_site_example and marketing-intelligence/information_architecture_website; codified as MANDATORY in article_writing/article-appearance-examples/ARTICLE_STYLING_GUIDE.md and sahha_work/SAHHA_BRAND_STYLE_GUIDE.md
signature: Geist at 20px/1.7 with a single vivid #2337ff accent on white — no gradients, generous whitespace
description: The canonical Sahha article style: stark white pages, grayscale ink, one electric blue #2337ff accent, Geist/Geist Mono typography at an oversized 20px base. Deliberately anti-gradient per the brand guide.

name: Purple Gradient Feature Article
lineage: Pre-guideline article style; explicitly banned by SAHHA_BRAND_STYLE_GUIDE.md ('Not purple/green gradients'); superseded by Sahha Resources Editorial
signature: full-page fixed #667eea->#764ba2 gradient with white metric cards
description: HealthKit-vs-API comparison article wrapped in the classic indigo-purple diagonal gradient, gray-900 typography and soft gradient metric cards. Kept as the documented 'what not to do' of the Sahha brand.

name: healthAPI.fit Docs
lineage: Original template of the family; biomarkerfit is the eye-friendly rebrand; an older copy lives in article_writing/healthapi.fit
signature: GitBook-style fixed sidebar + data-theme light/dark toggle using GitHub primer colors
description: GitBook-inspired documentation site for the healthAPI.fit brand: fixed 280px sidebar, GitHub-primer palette (#0969da accent) with a full dark mode (#0d1117), system font stack. Comparison pages (sahha-vs-rook etc.) share the theme.

name: BiomarkerFit Eye-Friendly
lineage: Rebrand/evolution of healthAPI.fit docs template; versions/ holds v1-initial, v2-educational, v4-ui-ux-fixes
signature: low-contrast 'eye-friendly' slate-gray palette with muted blue accents and 1.6 line height
description: BiomarkerFit iteration of the docs template tuned for eye comfort: warm-gray #fafbfc background, slate #2d3748 text and a desaturated #3182ce blue. Same page structure as healthAPI.fit but a softer, calmer mood.

name: Sahha EAP Wellness Dashboard
lineage: One dashboard codebase copied widely: marketing-intelligence/projects/EAP (+ siteground-demo-version, deployment-package, EAP_UI_overhaul) and MASTER_PROJECTS copies EAP-DEMO-SAHHA, sahha-wellness-dashboard, sahha_webhook_eap_demo, eap_update_webhook; identical tailwind.config.js tokens across all
signature: sahha.* tailwind namespace (#0066CC primary) plus a 5-step 'wellbeing' semantic scale from excellent green to critical red
description: Next.js corporate wellness/EAP dashboard on a slate-50 canvas: white cards with soft shadows, Sahha blue #0066CC charts, radar/pie/stacked-bar wellbeing visualizations and a dedicated wellbeing color scale (excellent #00AA44 -> critical #CC3333).

name: EAP UI Overhaul (Material)
lineage: MUI-based restyle experiment branching from the Sahha EAP dashboard (same API routes, Material theme.tsx instead of tailwind sahha.* tokens)
signature: Material blue #1976d2 with a deep purple #7c4dff secondary and MUI elevation cards
description: An 'overhaul' fork of the EAP dashboard rebuilt on Material-UI: standard Material blue primary, unexpected deep-purple secondary, gray-blue #f5f7fa background and elevated Paper surfaces with 600-weight tight-tracked headings.

name: Patient Voice Parchment Clinical
signature: parchment-beige gradient backdrop framing a cream 'paper sheet' container with brown rules
description: A warm parchment/cream clinical workbench: beige gradient desktop, ivory card container with tan borders, dark-brown ink, olive and amber action colors. Feels like a paper medical file instead of a SaaS app.

name: Patient Voice Triage Card
lineage: Standalone single-page variant of Patient Voice for Vercel; different visual language from the parchment main app
signature: vivid purple gradient full-bleed background with one large rounded white card
description: One-page 'AI Medical Triage' demo: saturated #667eea->#764ba2 gradient backdrop, a single floating white card with big rounded corners, emerald/red status accents. Classic hackathon-demo look.

name: Mosman Dry Eye Premium Medical
lineage: Clinic-site prototype of the OptiCore patient-management system (Mosman Dry Eye Clinic); the PMS itself continues in opticore/frontend and pms-rs
signature: navy #1e3a5f headings with gold #d4af37 accents — 'Premium Medical Aesthetic' framework
description: A luxury clinic marketing prototype: medical-white canvas, deep navy authority color, champagne-gold accent details, plus a matching login screen. positionQueued as 'Australia's Leading Dry Eye Treatment' with pill buttons and layered soft shadows.

name: OptiCore PMS Slate & Cream
lineage: Rust/Tauri rewrite of the OptiCore practice-management system; theme toggle stored as pms_theme, dark is default
signature: dark default (#0f1115 slate, #4f9cf9 blue) flipping to a warm cream paper light mode (#faf8f1)
description: Full clinic PMS UI (patients, calendar, checkout, analytics) with an unusual dual personality: a cool near-black slate dark mode with soft blue accents, and a warm cream 'paper' light mode with #2563eb actions. Compact 14px control-dense styling.

name: OptiCore Clinic Web
lineage: Vite+Tailwind web frontend of the OptiCore system; ModernApp.tsx (light) and ModernAppDark.tsx (slate+cyan) variants sit alongside SimpleApp.tsx
signature: tailwind blue-600 primary with cyan #06b6d4 highlights; dark variant swaps to slate-800 surfaces
description: Conventional clean Tailwind clinic dashboard: gray-100 canvas, white cards, blue-600 primary buttons and cyan accent stats, with a parallel slate/cyan dark variant (ModernAppDark). Practical and information-dense.
